title: Kokubu Group says 8,590 ROJI Nihonbashi Online Store records may have leaked via PLAID KARTE breach
date_note: 26 November is the day Kokubu Group published its notice; the page gives no earlier day.
geo_basis: Japan, as the company is Japanese; no city stated in the pages read
summary: Kokubu Group's notice of 26 November says that unauthorized access to Plaid's KARTE, used by its ROJI Nihonbashi Online Store, means some personal data may have leaked. Cybersecurity.com (Japan) puts the count at 8,590 records and says this is a number that may have leaked, not a confirmed leak. Kokubu says payment information and passwords are not included and no secondary harm had been confirmed as of 26 November.
plain: Kokubu Group says names and email addresses, and for some customers phone numbers, of its ROJI online store may have leaked from vendor Plaid's KARTE. Payment data and passwords are not included, it says.
exec: Kokubu says 8,590 records may have leaked (a possible, not confirmed, count); it reports no secondary harm as of 26 November.
action: Kokubu advises not answering calls from unknown numbers, not replying to suspicious emails, and not opening links or attachments in them.

evidence.quote: なお、8,590件は漏えいが確定した件数ではなく、漏えいの可能性がある件数である。

validation.note: Kokubu Group's own notice read; Cybersecurity.com (Japan) relays the same announcement.

review.note: title, date, 8,590 figure and quote, data types, advice, status checked against Kokubu notice and Cybersecurity.com
